name: Spencer Boldman
bio: Spencer Boldman (born July 28, 1992) is an American businessman, entrepreneur and actor. He is known for his role as Adam Davenport on Disney XD's Lab Rats, and for playing Gio in the film Cruise.

credits.title: You Can't Leave
credits.overview: Searching for a missing friend, a group enters a dark forest and discovers an abandoned cabin concealing an ancient evil. As night falls, they must survive the shadows and uncover the truth before it is too late.

credits.title: Cruise
credits.overview: Set in the 1980s, a young Italian-American from the wrong side of the tracks falls for a Jewish girl from Long Island.

credits.title: Zapped
credits.overview: Zoey is a talented dancer whose organized life is rudely disrupted when she moves in with her new step-dad and three step-brothers, until she discovers a dog-training app that can get boys to obey her every command. But she soon learns that it isn't the cure-all she had hoped for.
